sequence_description: JWT IdP: mint a control JWT and an attack JWT differing only by aud (wrong-aud). If wrong-aud is accepted, the broker may grant roles/identity despite upstream intent mismatch.
description:
Assertion FAILED: aud_atk_login_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: aud_atk_login_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: JWT IdP accepted a token with wrong aud, potentially granting a session outside the upstream intended audience (authorization binding failure)
